card.name: Words before a repeated or replaced item
card.fires_on: Small verbs and linking words (build, be, a, and, should) in sentences about something that is done again and again, such as nightly nests, moved sites, changed mixtures or kept-moist wicks. The next word is likely a recurrence word such as daily, every or once every.
